title: Cocycle description and collapse of the Grothendieck left edge
statement: Let $F:\mathcal A\to\mathcal B$ and $G:\mathcal B\to\mathcal C$ be a composable pair of left exact additive functors between Grothendieck abelian categories [def-sp-composite-acyclicity], with $F$ sending injectives to $G$-acyclics. Let $X\in\mathcal A$ and let $X\to I^\bullet$ be an injective resolution [def-sp-injective-resolutions]. Under the natural derived-functor identifications $R^n(G\circ F)(X)\cong H^n(G(F(I^\bullet)))$ and $R^nF(X)\cong H^n(F(I^\bullet))$ [lem-sp-derived-well-defined], the left edge map of [lem-sp-grothendieck-edge-maps] is the morphism $$H^n(G(F(I^\bullet)))\longrightarrow G(H^n(F(I^\bullet)))$$ induced by taking a degree-$n$ cocycle in $G(F(I^\bullet))$, regarding it by left exactness of $G$ as a section of $G(\ker(F(I^n)\to F(I^{n+1})))$, and applying $G$ to the quotient morphism $\ker(F(I^n)\to F(I^{n+1}))\to H^n(F(I^\bullet))$. In particular, if $R^pG(R^qF(X))=0$ for all $p>0$ and all $q\geq0$, this left edge map is an isomorphism in every degree: the first-quadrant spectral sequence of [thm-sp-grothendieck] has a finite, exhaustive, separated decreasing filtration of each abutment object, and [lem-sp-edge-collapse] applies to its exact couple [def-sp-exact-couple] and convergence [def-sp-convergence].

proof.text: For each n put K=F(I) and T=GF(I). Functoriality and iCycles_d show G(iCycles_K) followed by d_T is zero. Define c by T.liftCycles with this zero-composite proof. Mathlib liftCycles_i gives its inclusion equation. Apply [lem-pc-grothendieck-cocycle-comparison] to this c and inclusion equation for the quotient equation. This constructs the witnesses rather than postulating them.

Define HF(n).step(p) for every integer p by applying Subobject.exists of the canonical abutment isomorphism [lem-sp-grothendieck-edge-maps] to imageFiltration(n,n+1-p). Monotonicity imageFiltration_mono and functoriality on subobjects make this a [def-sp-filtration]. The proved upstream first-quadrant lemmas imageFiltration_eq_top and imageFiltration_eq_bot, and Subobject.map_top/map_bot, give step(0)=top and step(n+1)=bottom. These witnesses give IsFinite. A subobject containing all steps contains the zeroth top step, proving IsExhaustive; a subobject contained in all steps is contained in the (n+1)st bottom step, proving IsSeparated.

Use the proved upstream grothendieckSpectralObjectHIso to transfer the positive-derived-functor vanishing to H^{p+q}(q,q+1). For m=n and m=n+1, and q<n, choose p=m-q>0 to obtain H^m(q,q+1)=0. In the private proved helper interval_isZero, induction on a shows H^m(bot,a)=0 for a<=n: the base is the first-quadrant H^m(bot,0)=0, and the step applies SpectralObject.exact₂ and ShortComplex.Exact.isZero_of_both_isZero to bot<=a<=a+1. Consequently H^n(bot,n) and H^{n+1}(bot,n) are zero. Mathlib SpectralObject.isIso_H_map_twoδ₁Toδ₀' then makes H^n(bot,top)->H^n(n,top) an isomorphism. The proved upstream isIso_H_map_self_succ_top makes H^n(n,n+1)->H^n(n,top) an isomorphism. By the definition of leftEdge its composite with the inverse of this latter isomorphism is an isomorphism. Transport it through the abutment and target isomorphisms of grothendieckLeftEdgeMap. No new collapse axiom or exact-couple construction is used.
